title: Stoker plugins — timestamp
description: `index/v1/timestamp.json`: the one signed file of a compiled index. It pins every other file of the index by hash and size, and says how new the index is. Its signature is `index/v1/timestamp.json.sig`: the registry key's ECDSA P-256 signature with SHA-256 over this file's exact bytes, as IEEE P1363 (r and s, 32 bytes each), base64, nothing else in the file. A host refuses a timestamp whose `serial` is lower than the one it holds (an index rolled back) or whose `expires` has passed (an index held back), keeps what it has, and says so.

serial.description: Raised by one at least on every new index.

expires.description: After this a host stops taking the index as current. A registry signs a fresh timestamp before then even when nothing changed.
